protocol: per step: k=24 race, trimmed per-step stage_variance (delta_tie), 8 candidates spanning proxy ranks through the production tail; full-24 evaluate reserved for the most-live step (ranker capstone)

c1600.note: from the E1 full-24 campaign; all ties

c1400.note: AXIS LIVE, earlier than the headroom extrapolation predicted; noise floor tightened 48.8->15.4 as the clock hardened (cva6 pattern); ranker grade at n=7 not meaningful

c1300.closes_target: 0/8 -- the design's capability wall is ~1430ps; past it the target only changes how hard synthesis/repair fight

c1200.note: liveness plateaus at the ~1430ps wall; macro-path ranking STRENGTHENS under pressure (+0.95); achieved-period channel still unranked by the macro proxy at toy-n -- third consecutive near-zero

c1100.note: sweep complete. Curve: 0.49 / 2.73 / 3.24 / 2.52 / 3.15 -- switch-on between 1600 and 1400, plateau ~2.5-3.2 at the ~1430ps wall. Macro-path ranking robust under pressure (+0.89/+0.95); achieved channel at toy-n reads zero-or-below four straight steps

capstone.verdict: UNRANKABLE on the achieved-period channel, with mechanism: at the liveness peak the clock is set by generic std-cell paths, which are inherent noise w.r.t. the macro seed; the macro-path channel is rankable (+0.74) with 301.7ps of range (21.5x delta_tie) but never binds on swerv at stock utilization. Selection on this design buys macro-channel margin and implementability (1/24 draws fails PDN), not clock period. Macro selection pays on the period axis iff macro paths bind -- the binding test is macro_paths_worst vs the generic-path floor, which is exactly what a fast estimate can report per design.
